ruling.reasoning:
The trip is RydeTAXI, so the fare is metered and extra kilometres on an unexempted deviation enter the fare [F7][RD-2]. The record shows one off-route segment, 09:20–09:26, 4.04 km driven where the optimal route covers 1.86 km, adding 2.18 km [F3][RD-1]. No RD-4 exemption is available: no traffic incident on the replaced optimal stretch was recorded, and a speed band alone does not exempt under RD-4(b) in this MVP [F12][F15][RD-4]. So the case turns on RD-5 consent scope [F8][F9][RD-5].

The rider's own message "Just take whichever way is faster lah, I'm late" was sent at 09:18, before the segment began at 09:20 [F9][F3]. It names no road and no place [F9]. Under RD-5's three-scope reading it is a general route authorisation, which covers the route chosen to reach Changi T3 but not a stop or loop of the driver's own [RD-5]. The driver's offer [F8] was an alternative route to the same destination, the segment led onward to the airport, and there is no fact of a stop away from the route or an errand of the driver's own [F3][F9]. I therefore read this segment as a covered route choice → exempt [F9][F8][RD-5]. The driver's post-trip statement that the rider agreed verbally [F11] is a claim, not consent (G11), and I rely only on the rider's own timed message [F9][RD-5]. With the only segment exempt, the recoverable extra distance is 0 km, so the RD-2 formula (Σ unexempted extra_km × $30.46 ÷ 21.60 km = $1.4102/km) yields 0 [F3][F4][F7][RD-2]; a zero recoverable amount is no_action, though the record notes the driver's RD-1 duty [RD-2].

The contrary reading is acknowledged: the segment strayed up to 1027 m off the optimal route and the trip ran 10.2 min over estimate [F3][F2], which may suggest it was not in fact faster. My reading of RD-5 scope (1) is that it does not second-guess whether the chosen route was in fact fastest [F9][RD-5]. Because my finding changes the amount and I decide it (rather than leaving it undetermined), the case does not go to a person.

Rejected: the rider's refund ask (C3/C4/C8) rests on the segment counting; my RD-5 reading exempts it, so no distance refund is owed [F3][F9][RD-5]. The $0.11 metered waiting unit is a RydeTAXI wait and is not refundable [F5][RD-3]. No RD-6 flag: route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 for the driver [F18][RD-6]. Safety screen on F8/F9/F11/F10 found no threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation [F8][F9][F11].
